name: Vicky the Fox
storyline: The story begins in front of a warm campfire, where Vicky falls asleep peacefully on the night of October 4th. Upon waking, she realizes with great surprise that ten days have passed in the blink of an eye! Something is wrong with the flow of time. Vicky must embark on an incredible journey across enchanted worlds—from green prairies to arid deserts—to discover the truth behind the missing days and learn new abilities from the animal friends she meets along the way.
summary: In Vicky the Fox and the Lost Days, play as a curious fox on a journey to recover the ten missing days of 1582. Explore enchanted worlds, unlock 22 unique abilities from Animal Cards, and solve the mystery of the Great Animal Calendar in this non-violent, cozy platformer.
